# Majadroid Apocalyptic Buildings

- Source: https://opengameart.org/content/3d-apocalyptic-building-city-cc0
- Author: Majadroid / Maik Hoffmann
- Published: 2021-01-30
- License: Creative Commons Zero (CC0 1.0)
- Original archive: `lowpoly-apocalyptic-buildings-by-majadroid.zip`
- Archive SHA-256: `4117BD1D2E815223762C1DBD53E80EE050F64ED7E2B4B43A2BC00EBF20B7DF6B`

The FBX files and their original colour textures were copied unchanged from the
archive. The source `.blend` and brand images are intentionally omitted from the
Unity project because they are not runtime dependencies. Scene authoring must
preserve the supplied concrete, facade, rock, rust and billboard textures rather
than replacing them with proxy materials.
